common.title: Capability Jump
common.line: A discontinuous advance is released or demonstrated.

notable.title: Taiwan Blockade
notable.line: A quarantine or blockade halts advanced semiconductor exports.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Liability freeze utilities
notable.line: Municipal utilities in two member states suspend new AI-connected control upgrades after the winter agent incident, citing uninsurable liability, freezing resilience rollouts through year-end.

notable.title: Shadow continuity contracts
notable.line: Municipal utilities and hospital groups quietly sign direct continuity contracts with US hyperscalers for fallback inference and backup hosting, bypassing EU substitution timelines after the winter containment and ward walkouts.
